{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the population size
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients: {n_patients}')

# Compute response rates per arm
treatment_response_rate = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print all required numbers
print(f'treatment_response_rate: {treatment_response_rate}')
print(f'control_response_rate: {control_response_rate}')
print(f'treatment_effect: {treatment_effect}')"}
